senses.gloss: m., pl. סְרִיקִים, סְרִיקִין (Saf. of רֵק, v. סָרַק I) idlers, vagabonds. Tanḥ. Ki Thetsé 1 שסופו … עם הס׳ וכ׳ for he (the rebellious son) will finally waste his father’s fortune with the vagabonds with whom he eats &c.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 70b:8">Snh. 70ᵇ</cite> <he>חבורה שכולה ס׳</he> a company all of which are vagabonds.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Makhshirin 1:6">Makhsh. I, 6</cite> <he>מפני הס׳</he> Var. lect., v. <cite ref="O00824"><he>סִיקָרִין</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Kiddushin 82a:11">Kidd. 82ᵃ</cite> <he>הסריקים</he>, v. <cite ref="O01563"><he>סָרוֹק</he></cite>.]—[V. <cite ref="O01632"><he>סְרִיקִין</he></cite>.]
